rationale: Contract clause 4.2 fixes EUR 1.00 = USD 1.10 for Q1 2026, so the PO price of EUR 210.00 converts to USD 231.00 exactly matching the invoiced unit price — currency conversion under a contract rate is normalisation, not a defect (policy clause 7). Receipt GR-7711 confirms 40 EACH ordered, received and invoiced (clause 4), and recomputed tax at the vendor's 7.5% is USD 693.00, identical to the supplier's figure (clause 5). No credit memos; net payable USD 9,933.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
